item.text:
observation subject-counts
  Mathematics 110, physics 90, computing 80; pairwise counts 50, 45, and 35 include all-three students; all three is 20.

claim union-count
  Three-set inclusion-exclusion gives 110 + 90 + 80 - 50 - 45 - 35 + 20 = 170 students studying at least one subject.

claim none-count
  Of 200 students, 200 - 170 = 30 study none of the three subjects.

claim final-answer
  The answer is D.

link subject-counts supports union-count
link union-count supports none-count
link none-count supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 assumed
